import arrow
from dateutil import tz as dateutil_tz

# Create an Arrow at 2:30 AM on March 12, 2023 in US/Pacific (imaginary time)
# This is during the DST spring-forward gap
arw = arrow.Arrow(2023, 3, 12, 2, 30, tzinfo=dateutil_tz.gettz('US/Pacific'))
print(f"Created Arrow: {arw}")
print(f"Is imaginary? {arw.imaginary}")

# Now shift by 0 days - should return same result regardless of check_imaginary
result_default = arw.shift(days=0)
result_false = arw.shift(days=0, check_imaginary=False)
result_true = arw.shift(days=0, check_imaginary=True)

print(f"\nDefault: {result_default}, imaginary={result_default.imaginary}")
print(f"check_imaginary=False: {result_false}, imaginary={result_false.imaginary}")
print(f"check_imaginary=True: {result_true}, imaginary={result_true.imaginary}")
